GPU acquisition cost, achieved efficiencies, collective latency, 90% usable-HBM policy, electricity price, PUE, and every ROM value are assumptions and must be swept.

B300 capacity uses the official DGX B300 system guide's exact 8 x 288 GB = 2.3 TB device population. The February 2026 datasheet separately rounds/labels total memory as 2.1 TB; it is not divided into 262.5 GB devices.

GPU operating power uses official system-level maximum/busbar power divided by 8 so host and platform overhead are not silently omitted; x4 and x16 are pro-rata analytical configurations, not purchasable DGX SKUs.
ROM capacity is checkpoint bytes, not logical parameter count. HBM per ROM wafer is perimeter-limited.
